description:
**Role:**
Technical Production Support Engineer

**Location:**
India, Remote

**Experience:**
6+ Years

Algoworks

www.algoworks.com

**About the company**

Algoworks is an award-winning artificial intelligence, engineering services and experience transformation firm with offices across the United States, Europe, South America and India. Through collaboration, accountability and a focus on results, Algoworks operates at the intersection of technology and people, building not only advanced systems but strong global teams that elevate performance and create lasting impact.

Follow the video below to know about us!
Clipchamp

**Role overview**

We are seeking an experienced, hands-on
**Technical Production Support Engineer**
to provide technical leadership and oversee
**Tier 2/3 production support**
for a cloud-based SaaS platform serving the construction industry.

The role involves serving as the primary technical escalation point for complex production issues, leading incident investigations, driving root cause analysis, and ensuring timely resolution of critical application and infrastructure problems.

The successful candidate will work closely with Engineering, Customer Support, DevOps, and Product teams to maintain platform stability, improve support processes, and reduce recurring production issues. This is a hands-on technical leadership role requiring deep troubleshooting expertise, strong ownership, and the ability to guide and mentor other engineers.

**Key responsibilities:**

**1.Technical Production Support**

* Serve as the technical lead and primary escalation point for complex Tier 2/3 production incidents across applications, APIs, databases, and Azure infrastructure.
* Lead end-to-end incident investigation, troubleshooting, resolution, and technical escalation for high-priority production issues.
* Take ownership of critical incidents, ensuring timely diagnosis, stakeholder communication, and resolution within agreed service levels.
* Troubleshoot and debug applications across Angular, Next.js, TypeScript, .NET Core, C#, REST and GraphQL APIs, microservices, MongoDB, SQL Server, and Microsoft Azure.
* Guide and mentor support engineers in troubleshooting techniques, incident management, and technical problem-solving.
* Provide technical direction during complex investigations and coordinate cross-functional efforts to restore service.

**2.Incident Management & Root Cause Analysis**

* Lead technical investigations into recurring, high-impact, and business-critical production incidents.
* Perform detailed root cause analysis (RCA), identify underlying technical issues, and recommend corrective and preventive actions.
* Analyze application logs, telemetry, API responses, database performance, and infrastructure metrics using Azure Monitor, Application Insights, and related diagnostic tools.
* Investigate data inconsistencies, application errors, performance degradation, authentication failures, and integration issues.
* Write and optimize SQL and MongoDB queries to diagnose data-related incidents and performance bottlenecks.
* Partner with Engineering and DevOps teams to implement permanent fixes and reduce repeat incidents.
* Identify incident trends and recommend improvements to application reliability and operational stability.

**3.Operational Excellence & Process Improvement**

* Establish and improve production support processes, troubleshooting standards, escalation procedures, and incident response practices.
* Develop and maintain technical runbooks, knowledge base articles, troubleshooting documentation, and support procedures.
* Monitor production health, identify potential risks, and proactively address emerging issues.
* Support production deployments, release validation, and post-deployment monitoring.
* Track and improve operational performance, including incident response times, resolution times, recurring incidents, and support effectiveness.
* Identify opportunities to automate repetitive support tasks and improve operational efficiency.

**4.Cross-Functional Collaboration & Communication**

* Act as the technical liaison between Production Support, Engineering, DevOps, Customer Support, and Product teams.
* Coordinate with Engineering to prioritize production defects, validate resolutions, and track fixes through completion.
* Communicate incident status, technical findings, business impact, and resolution plans clearly to technical and non-technical stakeholders.
* Ensure timely communication during production incidents, including escalations, updates, and handoffs.
* Collaborate with distributed teams across the US and India, ensuring consistent coverage, availability, and knowledge transfer.
* Demonstrate accountability, responsiveness, and ownership of production support commitments.

**Required technical skills and competencies:**

* 8+ years of experience in Production Support, Application Support, Technical Support, or Software Engineering within enterprise or SaaS environments.
* 2+ years of experience in a technical lead, senior escalation, or incident management capacity.
* Strong hands-on experience troubleshooting and debugging C#/.NET Core applications, REST APIs, and microservices.
* Strong working knowledge of Angular-based web applications and frontend-to-backend troubleshooting.
* Advanced SQL troubleshooting skills, including complex queries, joins, execution plans, and performance investigation.
* Hands-on experience with MongoDB, including query troubleshooting, data investigation, and indexing concepts.
* Strong production support experience with Microsoft Azure, including application hosting, monitoring, and infrastructure troubleshooting.
* Experience using Azure Application Insights, Azure Monitor, and log analysis tools to investigate production incidents.
* Demonstrated ability to lead root cause investigations and drive permanent resolutions for recurring production issues.
* Experience with incident management, escalation procedures, and SLA-driven support environments.
* Strong understanding of Azure DevOps, Git, CI/CD pipelines, and production deployment processes.
* Ability to troubleshoot complex issues across multiple application and infrastructure layers.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including explaining technical issues to non-technical stakeholders.
* Strong leadership, ownership, prioritization, and problem-solving skills.
* Ability to mentor engineers, coordinate cross-functional teams, and drive incident resolution with minimal supervision.

**Must have skills:**

* 8+ years of experience in Production Support, Application Support, Technical Support, or Software Engineering.
* 2+ years of technical leadership, senior escalation, or incident management experience.
* Strong hands-on experience with C# and .NET Core application troubleshooting.
* Experience troubleshooting REST APIs and microservices.
* Working knowledge of Angular-based applications and frontend-to-backend issues.
* Advanced SQL troubleshooting, query optimization, and database performance investigation.
* Hands-on MongoDB experience, including queries, data investigation, and indexing concepts.
* Production support experience with Microsoft Azure.
* Experience with Azure Monitor, Application Insights, and log analysis.
* Strong root cause analysis and incident management capabilities.
* Knowledge of Azure DevOps, Git, CI/CD pipelines, and production deployment processes.
* Excellent communication, ownership, and cross-functional coordination skills.

**Good to have skills:**

* Experience supporting large-scale, multi-tenant SaaS platforms.
* Experience with Next.js, TypeScript, Material-UI, and responsive web applications.
* Experience troubleshooting authentication and authorization using OAuth, JWT, Azure AD B2C, NextAuth.js, or MSAL-Angular.
* Familiarity with performance optimization, distributed tracing, and microservices troubleshooting.
* Experience improving operations through automation, monitoring, and proactive issue detection.
* Familiarity with ITIL practices, incident management, problem management, and post-incident reviews.
* Experience working with geographically distributed engineering and support teams.

**Desired attributes:**

* Strong technical ownership and the ability to independently manage critical production incidents.
* Excellent troubleshooting, analytical, and root cause analysis skills.
* Ability to guide and mentor engineers through complex technical investigations.
* Strong prioritization and decision-making skills under pressure.
* Clear, proactive, and transparent communication with technical and non-technical stakeholders.
* Ability to collaborate across Engineering, DevOps, Customer Support, and Product teams.
* Focus on operational excellence, platform stability, and continuous improvement.
* Ability to work independently while coordinating cross-functional incident resolution.

**Success criteria:**

* Critical production incidents are owned, coordinated, and resolved with minimal disruption.
* Complex technical escalations are investigated thoroughly and addressed without excessive dependency on Engineering.
* Recurring production problems are reduced through permanent corrective actions.
* Support engineers receive effective technical guidance, improving team troubleshooting capabilities.
* Communication with Customer Support, Engineering, and business stakeholders is proactive and transparent.
* Production support processes, documentation, and operational metrics continuously improve.
* The team demonstrates strong accountability, technical ownership, and operational reliability.

title: Senior Databricks Architect
description:
We are looking for an experienced Senior Databricks Architect with 10–15 years of IT experience to lead enterprise-scale Lakehouse architecture, platform modernization, data governance, and migration initiatives. The candidate should have strong hands-on expertise in Databricks, Apache Spark, PySpark, Delta Lake, and Unity Catalog, along with the ability to define architecture strategies, engineering standards, performance optimization, and cloud data platform roadmaps.
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  
Design and lead enterprise-scale Databricks Lakehouse architecture, including workspace strategy, Unity Catalog, storage, compute, and Medallion architecture.
  
  
Define architecture standards and best practices for Databricks, PySpark, Spark SQL, Delta Lake, DLT/Lakeflow, Workflows, and Auto Loader.
  
  
Lead large-scale data platform modernization and migration from legacy data warehouses, Hadoop, and ETL platforms to Databricks.

Build AI-ready data foundations and demonstrate awareness of RAG, Vector Search, MLflow, Model Serving, and AI governance.
  
  
Lead architecture workshops, engage with business and technical stakeholders, define technology roadmaps, and mentor engineering teams.
  
  
Mandatory Skills
  
  
10–15 years of overall IT experience with significant experience in Data Engineering and Architecture.
  
  
Strong expertise in Databricks Lakehouse Architecture and Apache Spark.
  
  
Hands-on experience with PySpark, Spark SQL, Delta Lake, and Medallion Architecture.
  
  
Strong knowledge of Unity Catalog, Data Governance, Security, and Data Lineage.
  
  
Experience designing enterprise-scale cloud data platforms on AWS, Azure, or GCP.
  
  
Expertise in data migration, modernization, performance tuning, and platform optimization.
  
  
Experience with CI/CD, DevOps, Terraform/IaC, and production-grade data platform engineering.
  
  
Strong architecture leadership, stakeholder management, solution design, and technical mentoring skills.

Experience with Lakeflow Declarative Pipelines / Delta Live Tables (DLT), Auto Loader, and Databricks Workflows.
  
  
Knowledge of Structured Streaming, CDC, SCD, and Delta Sharing.
  
  
Exposure to Databricks Asset Bundles, system tables, Lakehouse Federation, and serverless compute.
  
  
Awareness of MLflow, Vector Search, RAG, and AI/ML platform integration.
  
  
**Experience In Enterprise FinOps, Chargeback/showback, And Cloud Cost Governance.**

+ IDocs

+ BAPIs

* Ability to prepare functional specifications and support testing activities.

description:
Location: Noida, India
  
  
Thales is a global technology leader trusted by governments, institutions, and enterprises to tackle their most demanding challenges. From quantum applications and artificial intelligence to cybersecurity and 6G innovation, our solutions empower critical decisions rooted in human intelligence. Operating at the forefront of aerospace and space, cybersecurity and digital identity, we’re driven by a mission to build a future we can all trust.
  
  
Present in India since 1953, Thales is headquartered in Noida and has other operational offices and sites spread across Delhi, Gurugram, Bengaluru and Mumbai, among others. Over 2200 employees are working with Thales and its joint ventures in India. Since the beginning, Thales has been playing an essential role in India’s growth story by sharing its technologies and expertise in Defence, Aerospace and Cyber & Digital sectors. Thales has two engineering competence centres in India - one in Noida focused on Cyber & Digital business, while the one in Bengaluru focuses on hardware, software and systems engineering capabilities for both the civil and defence sectors, serving global needs. The Group has also established an MRO (Maintenance, Repair & Overhaul) facility in Gurugram to provide comprehensive avionics maintenance and repair services to Indian airlines and support the growth of the local aviation industry.
  
  
**Position Summary**
This position is responsible for maintaining user and system uptime on Thales InFlyt Experience’s Ground System that is the source for all In-Flight Entertainment on many commercial airlines throughout the world. Technical TechOps Lead should exhibit strong technical and communication skills to collaborate with team, product management, technical support, and customer. Spends more than 75% time as individual contributor and rest for other activities. Should have complete understanding of the product, including the end-to-end use cases. Works with complete autonomy, not needing any guidance. The TechOps Technical Lead will be responsible for improving system experiences through remote monitoring, maintenance and problem identification and resolution activities, as well as growing and developing the organization’s perception with existing customers through exceptional customer service. Will be responsible to mentor the team members and act as an escalation point for any unresolved issues from the Level I/II team.
  
  
**Essential Functions / Key Areas Of Responsibility**

* Windows Server Monitoring, Maintenance and Support
* Web-based Application Monitoring, Maintenance and Support
* Identifying, documenting and troubleshooting network, systems, applications and cloud issues to resolution.
* Ground System Incident and Problem Management
* Assisting with the management of technical documentation which supports the development and/or improvement of Operational and Monitoring procedures and platform application/system testing.
* Design, implement, and maintain monitoring systems using Datadog, building dashboards, monitors, and alerts to proactively identify and resolve issues.
* Collaborate with cross-functional teams to define, implement, and improve operational processes and best practices.
* Oversee the configuration and management of GitLab, Terraform, and other DevOps tools to streamline deployment and infrastructure management.
* Performing daily system monitoring, verifying the integrity and availability of all hardware, networking equipment, server resources, systems and key processes, reviewing system, error and application logs, and verifying completion of scheduled jobs and tasks.
* Production and Test environments platform monitoring for alarms and performance issues on systems, applications, database and network connectivity.
* Working rotating shifts in a 24x7 NOC environment
* Performing assigned daily, weekly and monthly operations maintenance duties.
* Operating system provisioning and maintenance
* Application and operating system service restarts
* Performs Enterprise back-up and restorations
* Assists in knowledgebase management
* Assist with changes to platform hardware and software
* Resolves application, database and operating system related monitoring events
* Troubleshoots LAN/WAN
* Performs Moves, Adds and Changes within the monitoring environments
* Work effectively with internal/external technical resources and customer-facing organizations to resolve incidents quickly and efficiently
* Follows prescribed processes for Incident, Change and Problem management
* Mentors L1/L2 TechOps Engineers
* Cross Training Departmental Team Members
* Stay current with industry trends, emerging technologies, and best practices to continuously improve the TechOps team's capabilities and deliverables.
* Other duties as assigned by Manager

**Minimum Requirements: Skills, Experience, Education, Technical/Specialized Knowledge, Certifications, Language**

* undefined
* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent experience.
* 5+ years of experience in technical operations, with a strong background in building and maintaining monitoring systems.
* Proficiency in Linux, Windows, Datadog, GitLab, Terraform, and Kubernetes.
* Minimum 2 year experience of Network infrastructure, Microsoft Windows and Linux Systems and Servers (Windows Server 2012, 2008, 2003, Windows 8/7/XP, RedHat)
* Comfortable with handling major outages and experience in Network and Systems monitoring
* In-depth knowledge of Datadog, Gitlab, Terraform, Visual Studio Code, Kubernetes.
* Experience in monitoring a 24X7 environment.
* Must be available to participate in 24x7 shift rotation.
* Experience developing, documenting and maintaining installation and configuration procedures.
* Must be able to convey technical topics clearly and communicate professionally to customers
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
* Excellent analytical and problem solving skills
* Excellent customer service skills
* Ability to learn and adapt to new technologies and methodologies.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* One (1) Year Experience of Network, Windows and Linux Server Monitoring and Administration specifically in an Enterprise Environment
* One (1) Year Experience in systems monitoring and long term trending of SLA, performance and sizing metrics related to reporting.
* Possess a Certified Kubernetes Administrator (CKA) certification, demonstrating expertise in Kubernetes concepts and best practices.
* Enjoys troubleshooting and solving problems
* Familiarity with ITIL standards, Number Portability, Telecommunications and Networking (including satellite-based network connectivity) is a plus.
* Familiarity with scripting languages like Powershell and BASH for system administration tasks
* Familiarity with Kubernetes, cloud computing models like Platform-as-a-Service and Software-as-a-Service
* Experience with virtualization environments such as VMware and AWS EC2
* Experience with administrative tasks on cloud providers such as Azure including Azure Active Directory

At Thales, we’re committed to fostering a workplace where respect, trust, collaboration, and passion drive everything we do. Here, you’ll feel empowered to bring your best self, thrive in a supportive culture, and love the work you do. Join us, and be part of a team reimagining technology to create solutions that truly make a difference – for a safer, greener, and more inclusive world.

title: Lead Data Advisor
description:
**What Makes Us, Us**
Join some of the most innovative thinkers in FinTech as we lead the evolution of financial technology. If you are an innovative, curious, collaborative person who embraces challenges and wants to grow, learn and pursue outcomes with our prestigious financial clients, say Hello to SimCorp!
  
  
At its foundation, SimCorp is guided by our values — caring, customer success-driven, collaborative, curious, and courageous. Our people-centered organization focuses on skills development, relationship building, and client success. We take pride in cultivating an environment where all team members can grow, feel heard, valued, and empowered.
  
  
If you like what we’re saying, keep reading!
  
  
**WHY THIS ROLE IS IMPORTANT TO US**
SimCorp DMS is a complete data management solution for pricing and reference data, provided as a Managed Service. The SimCorp DMS Advisory and change management service is a team of industry and data management experts who consistently monitor for any industry, regulatory and vendor feed changes that may affect our client’s business operations. The Advisory Service regularly informs clients of these changes, and how best to adapt.
  
  
As a Senior Data Advisor, you will be responsible to look after the client onboarding, monitoring vendor changes, maintaining the standard data model and orchestrating change management activities for the SimCorp DMS clients by liaising with internal service teams from IT and Operations. You will be directly reporting to the head of Data Advisory team
  
  
**What You Will Be Responsible For**

* Create and maintain data standards (lookups, mappings, conventions, and rules), data models and data ontologies (how are data objects related to each other)
* Maintain meta data information documentation regarding data models, data interpretation, data lineage and utilization along the key processes and make it available to internal and external stakeholders.
* Monitor, track and conduct assessment of all vendors related changes that impacts SimCorp DMS and Enterprise Data Manager clients.
* Facilitate Change & Control Board (CCB) governance with internal service teams to prioritize and deliver the standard and client change requests.
* Design and implement a robust client onboarding framework for a seamless DMS client onboarding
* Serve as the advisor and quality gateway regarding data and change integrations related to data.
* Support design and maintenance of an overall data test concepts and conduct regular data tests to assure data and service quality.
* Support DMS Operations on various process improvement initiatives.
* Advise clients on data needs and data usage for new requirements.
* Build and maintain in-depth know-how on industry and regulatory changes within data management.
* This is a client-centric role that involves regular interaction with our valued customers
* Continuously develop a comprehensive understanding of the latest industry and regulatory trends in the data management space and promote best practices within the SimCorp community to benefit our clients.

**What We Value**
Most importantly, you can see yourself contributing and thriving in the position described above. How you gained the skills needed for doing that is less important. We expect you to be good at several of the following and be able to - and interested in - learning the rest.
  
  

* Have a relevant bachelor’s degree or equivalent in finance
* Relevant experience in areas of Change Management with data vendor feeds (Bloomberg, IDC, Reuters, etc.)
* Have good knowledge of financial products and markets including derivatives, structured instruments etc.
* Have experience in requirements engineering, data modelling and full SDLC approach.
* Have a structured approach, attention to detail, service mindset, and solid organizational and interpersonal skills.
* Process management, control and design experience are beneficial skills but not mandatory.
* Have relevant experience in Data Management and Business Analysis
* Possess strong knowledge of various investment/trade lifecycle activities
* Show the ability to collaborate easily with various departments to ensure client success.
* Exhibit clear verbal and written communication to engage and inform various stakeholders

**Benefits**

* Global hybrid work policy - We ask you to work 2 days a week from the office. If you choose you can work remotely the other days. Of course you are welcome at the office if that is your preference.
* Growth and innovation - Every 6th sprint is reserved for planning and innovation. So, with regular intervals you have a chance to explore and learn new skills or improve something that you believe will be beneficial to you, your team or the application.
* Self-Direction - High degree of self-organization. Each team and developer have a high degree of freedom to plan, organize and design their work.
* Inclusive and diverse company culture
* Work-life balance – We believe that an equilibrium between professional responsibilities makes us all the best version of ourselves, both in private life and as colleagues in the workplace
* Empowerment – We believe that all voices are valuable and must be heard. You will be involved in shaping our work processes

**NEXT STEPS**
Please send us your application in English via our career site as soon as possible, we process incoming applications continually. Please note that only applications sent through our system will be processed. At SimCorp, we recognize that bias can unintentionally occur in the recruitment process. To uphold fairness and equal opportunities for all applicants, we kindly ask you to exclude personal data such as photo, age, or any non-professional information from your application. Thank you for aiding us in our endeavor to mitigate biases in our recruitment process.
  
  
If you are interested in being a part of SimCorp but are not sure this role is suitable, submit your CV anyway. SimCorp is on an exciting growth journey, and our Talent Acquisition Team is ready to assist you discover the right role for you. The approximate time to consider your CV is three weeks.
  
  
We are eager to continually improve our talent acquisition process and make everyone’s experience positive and valuable. Therefore, during the process we will ask you to provide your feedback, which is highly appreciated.
  
  
**Who We Are**
For over 50 years, we have worked closely with investment and asset managers to become the world’s leading provider of integrated investment management solutions. We are 3,000+ colleagues with a broad range of nationalities, educations, professional experiences, ages, and backgrounds.
  
  
SimCorp is an independent subsidiary of the Deutsche Börse Group. Following the recent merger with Axioma, we leverage the combined strength of our brands to provide an industry-leading, full, front-to-back offering for our clients.
  
  
SimCorp is an equal opportunity employer and welcome applicants from all backgrounds, without regard to race, gender, age, disability, or any other protected status under applicable law. We are committed to building a culture where diverse perspectives and expertise are integrated into our everyday work. We believe in the continual growth and development of our employees, so that we can provide best-in-class solutions to our clients.

Join Risk and Compliance Transformation Team and you will work with multi-disciplinary teams from around the world to deliver a global perspective. Aligned to key industry groups including Asset management, Banking and Capital Markets, Insurance and Private Equity, Health, Government, Power and Utilities, we provide integrated advisory, assurance, tax, and transaction services. * Map data movements, transformations and interfaces across reporting systems

* Provide functional support to all phases of delivery (Sprints, Testing, Hypercare etc.)

**Required Skills**
**Skills and attributes for success**

* 4-9 years of experience in data used for risk, financial and supervisory reporting within the broader data governance context, with right mix of practical lineage capability and strong analytical, investigative, documentation and stakeholder-management skills
* Working experience in Capital Adequacy and Risk Exposures (any 1 or more subject areas of  capital adequacy, own funds, credit risk, market risk, operational risk, leverage, liquidity metrics, large exposures, asset encumbrance)
* Working experience in:

+ Source-system analysis and data extraction processes
+ Mapping of data movements, transformations and interfaces across reporting systems
+ Automation of lineage capture and documentation activities
+ Data catalogue, metadata repository and reporting architecture initiatives
+ Identification of report owners, critical data elements and reporting metrics
+ Documentation and validation of end-to-end reporting lineage
+ Maintenance of reporting inventories, controls and governance documentation
+ Coordination with Data Office, Finance, Risk Management and other stakeholders
+ Good to have:

- Support during regulatory reviews and onsite inspections
- IFRS 9 ECL Models
- Mapping of PD, LGD and EAD inputs, staging, forward-looking information, calibrations, overlays and calculation outputs
- Documentation of model dependencies, assumptions, controls, reconciliations, governance, validation and approvals

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Certifications: Any Data Engineering certifications such as AWS Data Engineer Certification, Azure Data Engineer Certification, Google Cloud Professional Data Engineer
* AI or ML Certifications

**Education**
:
  
  

* Degree: Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Technology, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience

**What We Offer**
EY Global Delivery Services (GDS) is a dynamic and truly global delivery network. We work across six locations – Argentina, China, India, the Philippines, Poland and the UK – and with teams from all EY service lines, geographies and sectors, playing a vital role in the delivery of the EY growth strategy. From accountants to coders to advisory consultants, we offer a wide variety of fulfilling career opportunities that span all business disciplines. In GDS, you will collaborate with EY teams on exciting projects and work with well-known brands from across the globe. We’ll introduce you to an ever-expanding ecosystem of people, learning, skills and insights that will stay with you throughout your career.
  
  

* Continuous learning: You’ll develop the mindset and skills to navigate whatever comes next.
* Success as defined by you: We’ll provide the tools and flexibility, so you can make a meaningful impact, your way.
* Transformative leadership: We’ll give you the insights, coaching and confidence to be the leader the world needs.

**EY | Building a better working world**
EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.
  
  
Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.
  
  
Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.

title: Consultant Cloud Operations
description:
Join us at Orange Business!
  
  
We are a network and digital integrator that understands the entire value chain of the digital world, freeing our customers to focus on the strategic initiatives that shape their business.
  
  
Every day, you will collaborate with a team dedicated to providing consistent, sustainable global solutions, no matter where our customers operate. With over 30,000 employees across Asia, the Americas, Africa, and Europe, we offer a dynamic environment to develop and perfect your skills in a field filled with exciting challenges and opportunities.
  
  
**About The Role**

* Leverage your expertise in backup and restore administration to ensure data integrity and continuity across cloud infrastructures, driving operational excellence and supporting complex technical environments.
* Administer, configure, and troubleshoot backup and restore solutions including Veritas NetBackup, Commvault, and Veeam to maintain data protection reliability.
* Manage NetBackup self-service (NSS) and appliance environments to optimize backup workflows and user accessibility.\
* Plan and execute migration, upgradation, and troubleshooting tasks for NetBackup and Commvault systems to enhance infrastructure capabilities.
* Configure and resolve issues related to VM backup as well as SQL, Domino, and Exchange backups and restores.
* Maintain a comprehensive understanding of NetBackup Self Service integration with Master and Media Servers to support smooth operations.
* Analyze backup architecture to identify improvement opportunities and address failure issues effectively.
* Provide hardware support for tape libraries and tape drives to resolve physical backup system challenges.
* Quickly assimilate new technologies related to backup and storage domains, applying innovative solutions as necessary.
* Communicate clearly and thoroughly with business teams to define issues and convey technical information.
* Support project teams as a technical specialist in storage and backup infrastructure design and deployment.
* Manage complex incidents and crisis situations with a structured approach to minimize impact.
* Coordinate validations and technical activities during extensive changes and participate in Change Advisory Board (CAB) meetings when required.
* Develop detailed runbooks for product upgrades and infrastructure expansions to standardize procedures.
* Prepare root cause analysis (RCA) for high-priority incidents (P1/P2) and perform post-implementation reviews (PIR) for changes that fail to deliver expected results.
* Lead and participate in on-call rotations to provide 24X7 technical support when schedule demands.

**About You**
You bring substantial experience in administration, configuration, and troubleshooting of backup and restore technologies including Veritas NetBackup, Commvault, and Veeam, along with strong knowledge of NetBackup self-service and appliance components.
  
  
With a background of at least seven years and a degree in a relevant field, you have proven skills in managing complex backup architectures, rapid adoption of new technologies, and clear communication to stakeholders.
  
  
Your ability to lead technical coordination and contribute to project teams defines you as a dedicated technical specialist in storage and backup infrastructure.
  
  
**Your professional skills:**

* Demonstrates expertise in administration, configuration, and troubleshooting of backup and restore tools such as Veritas NetBackup, Commvault, and Veeam.
* Applies knowledge of NetBackup self-service (NSS) and appliance configurations to optimize backup operations.
* Manages complex migration and upgrade projects for backup solutions, ensuring minimal operational disruption.
* Configures and troubleshoots VM, SQL, Domino, and Exchange backup and restore scenarios with precision.
* Interprets backup architecture and storage infrastructure to identify and resolve failure issues efficiently.
* Handles hardware troubleshooting for tape libraries and tape drives to support physical backup media.

The One Platform Principal Operations analyst Data Output plays a key execution role in the rollout, setup, and validation client output in our One Platform ecosystem, with a strong focus on eClipse/NRSP and its integration with upstream and downstream platforms for the set up and BAU maintenance (e.g., OGRDS, Delivery Management, On Demand, Sirval, Madras and T&D DWH). On the validation part focus will be on data correctness and client specification correctness across all dimensions

This role is designed for an execution analyst who ensures that client set up in One Platform is executed properly and according to the country rollout schedule, validates the client output vs. Legacy and vs. defined specs to sign off and handover to the commercial teams. And manages any additional BAU maintenance activities required in eClipse/NRSP for delivery in Discover according to delivery commitments

Job Responsibilities

Platform Setup & Rollout Execution

* Support initial setup and configuration activities in eClipse/NRSP as part of One Platform onboarding of clients across countries. Using the available automation tools and load functionalities

* Executes the output checks on both data correctness as well as the client specifications. Using automated comparison tools

* Supports the RCA in case of issues identified during the output checks

* Executes corrections needed in eClipse/NRSP when needed as an outcome of the RCA on identified issues

BAU Operations & Monitoring

* Perform day‑to‑day operational monitoring of One Platform processes in BAU.

* Identify, analyse, and support resolution of operational issues across platform flows.

* Participate actively in regular platform governance and working sessions.

Role Requirements

Required Skills & Experience

* Technical & Domain Knowledge

* Working knowledge of eClipse/NRSP (configuration, monitoring, BAU flows).

* Basic understanding of T&D DWH confirmed layer and data flows.

* Experience working with enterprise data platforms or operational systems.

* Analytical skills

**Qualifications**

* 2–3 years’ experience in operations, execution roles within data‑driven or platform‑based environments.

* Hands‑on experience supporting system rollout, BAU operations, or platform stabilization.

* Exposure to multi‑country or global operating models is preferred.

Ways of Working

* Strong execution mindset with attention to detail and operational discipline.

* Ability to work effectively in cross‑functional and cross‑regional teams.

* Comfortable operating in environments with delivery deadlines and the pressure of a high profile project.

* Clear verbal and written communication skills in English.

Profile Fit

This role is suited to someone who:

* Enjoys hands‑on execution

* Is comfortable working close to operational reality and BAU constraints.

* Dedicated to deliver against commitments

Career Path & Growth

This role offers exposure to:

* Global platform transformation initiatives.

* Cross‑system and cross‑functional collaboration.

* Future growth into senior execution, platform operations, or transformation roles.

**Additional Information**

The role is at B3 level

* Flexible working environment
* Volunteer time off
* LinkedIn Learning

title: Software Development Engineer II
description:
At Expedia Group, we help travelers explore the world, one journey at a time. As a global travel company powered by passionate people, trusted partnerships, and leading technology, we connect travelers, partners, and advertisers through our consumer brands, B2B network, and travel advertising business.
  
  
Here, you'll do meaningful work that helps millions of people discover, book, and experience travel with more ease, confidence, and joy. Our five Behaviors-Traveler First, Think Big, Operate with Excellence, Ownership Mindset, and Succeed Together-help foster a supportive environment where people can grow their careers and have the flexibility, benefits, and support to do their best work. Join us and build for travelers everywhere.
  
  
Expedia Group powers global travel for everyone, everywhere. We design cutting-edge technology to make travel smoother and more memorable, and we create groundbreaking solutions for our partners. Our diverse, vibrant, and welcoming community is essential to driving our success. A singular technology platform powered by data and machine learning provides secure, differentiated, and personalized experiences that drive loyalty and traveler satisfaction.
  
  
**About The Team – EG Clickstream**
EG Clickstream provides data that captures user behavior and experience across Expedia Group sites and apps. This data forms the building blocks for understanding user journeys: what products users search for, which features they see and use, and which marketing channels they arrive from. It powers analysis of Product and Marketing performance to support optimized decision-making and can also be used programmatically to drive personalized, adaptive experiences for our users.
  
  
**About The Role**
As a Software Development Engineer II on Expedia Group’s Clickstream team, you will design, build, and operate the real-time data platform that captures and processes user behavior across our sites and apps. You will engineer scalable, resilient streaming systems that power analytics, marketing, and personalized experiences globally. You bring strong analytical and troubleshooting skills, deep proficiency in coding and distributed systems design, and a passion for solving complex problems of scale. You are collaborative, creative, and thrive in a dynamic, agile environment where you continuously learn and raise the bar.
  
  
What you will do
  
  

* Design, build, and operate highly available, low-latency streaming services and data pipelines (primarily in Java/Kotlin) running in public/hybrid cloud environments.
* Write clean, efficient, well-tested code; practice pair programming and conduct thorough code reviews.
* Apply object-oriented design, distributed computing, performance/scalability tuning, and advanced data structures/algorithms to real-time streaming and data processing.
* Build and evolve microservices and data APIs that power analytics and personalized experiences.
* Implement robust testing, monitoring, alerting, and observability to ensure reliability and rapid incident response.
* Troubleshoot complex production issues, perform root-cause analysis, and drive long-term fixes and improvements.
* Collaborate with product managers, data engineers, analysts, and platform teams to deliver high-impact solutions.
* Contribute to technical design documents; communicate trade-offs and decisions clearly within the team.
* Stay current with advancements in cloud data platforms, streaming technologies, and best practices; mentor junior engineers.

Who you are
  
  

* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science or a related field, or equivalent professional experience.
* 2+ years of professional software development experience, including building and operating backend/microservices in Java; Kotlin or Scala experience is a plus.
* Hands-on experience with streaming platforms (e.g., Kafka, Kinesis, Pub/Sub) and event-driven architectures.
* Experience building production-grade data processing applications in public/hybrid cloud environments (e.g., AWS, GCP, Azure).
* Solid understanding of software engineering fundamentals: algorithms, data structures, concurrency, distributed systems, and design patterns.
* Proficiency in testing strategies (unit, integration), CI/CD, monitoring, alerting, and incident management.
* Familiarity with observability concepts and tools to monitor application health and performance.
* Strong debugging, problem-solving, communication, and collaboration skills; self-starter with a learning mindset.
* Familiarity with basic AI tools (e.g., GitHub Copilot, code assistants) to accelerate development or documentation, used responsibly within company policies.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience with Kafka Streams (KStream) and/or Apache Flink for stateful stream processing.
* Familiarity with schema registry, data lake technologies, and data quality frameworks

**Accommodation requests**
Expedia Group is committed to providing an inclusive and accessible recruiting experience. If you need an accommodation or adjustment due to a disability during the application or recruiting process, please submit a request at https://expedia.service-now.com/askeg?id=job\_accommodation.
  
  
**About Expedia Group**
Expedia Group includes three flagship consumer brands - Expedia, Hotels.com, and Vrbo - along with a leading B2B travel business and travel advertising offerings. Across our brands and business, we help travelers explore the world with confidence and ease.

title: Senior Engineer - Cloud
description:
**What makes this a great opportunity?**
Role's mission is to Participate in the design, deployment, and management of cloud infrastructure and services with specific focus on multi cloud network architectures. Core scope includes Microsoft Azure and Google Cloud Platform (GCP). Accountable for effective planning, organizing, and maintaining overall landscape to ensure the stable management of the organization’s cloud infrastructure. The ideal candidate will have a foundational understanding of cloud network technologies, strong problem-solving skills and structured approach to activities aligned to the defined operating model.
  
  
**Role Responsibilities**

* Design and implement cloud networking across Azure, AWS, and GCP (VNets, VPCs, and VPC Networks)
* Collaborate with architects and developers to deploy and manage cloud-based applications and services.
* Define system requirements in alignment with application architects and owners
* Implement automation of cloud infrastructure deployment and management using DevOps tools including Infrastructure as Code (IaC) tools (e.g., Terraform).
* Provide L3 escalation for daily operations of cloud network infrastructure, to ensure security and stability.
* Drive the implementation of cloud security best practices and compliance requirements.
* Configure and manage DNS and name resolution services
* Implement network peering, transit connectivity, and hybrid networking
* Deploy and manage VPN gateways, virtual network gateways, and cloud WAN solutions
* Design and implement dedicated private connectivity (Azure ExpressRoute, Google Cloud Interconnect)
* Configure and manage load balancing and global traffic distribution
* Deploy application delivery controllers and web application gateways
* Implement global application access and edge networking (Azure Front Door, Cloud CDN/Load Balancing)
* Configure DDoS protection and network security controls
* Deploy and manage cloud-native firewalls and firewall policy management
* Secure network connectivity using private endpoints, Private Link, service endpoints, and private service connect
* Implement network segmentation, routing, and access control policies
* Support hybrid and multi-cloud connectivity architectures with centralized governance and observability
* Collaborate in the development of documentation for cloud architecture, processes, and procedures.
* Stay updated on industry trends and advancements in cloud technologies and services.
* Collaborate with cross-functional teams to support cloud-related projects and initiatives.
* Responsible for monitoring the consumption of cloud resources, request fulfillment turnaround, application performance, and systems security posture.
* Execute cloud FinOps and cost management.

Team relationship
  
  
  

* Vendor Management – Ability to work with managed infrastructure teams on shore – offshore support teams.
* Involved activities with other Support Leads, Support Partner, Third Parties, other IT Infrastructure Groups, and security groups.

**Qualifications**

* Education - Bachelor of Science degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or related discipline.
* Certifications – MS Azure Administrator Associate/GCP Cloud Engineer is a plus
* Level of Experience: 7 years of experience in cloud engineering, preferably in consulting and integration companies

Location: Noida, India

Thales is a global technology leader trusted by governments, institutions, and enterprises to tackle their most demanding challenges. From quantum applications and artificial intelligence to cybersecurity and 6G innovation, our solutions empower critical decisions rooted in human intelligence. Operating at the forefront of aerospace and space, cybersecurity and digital identity, we’re driven by a mission to build a future we can all trust.

Present in India since 1953, Thales is headquartered in Noida and has other operational offices and sites spread across Delhi, Gurugram, Bengaluru and Mumbai, among others. Over 2200 employees are working with Thales and its joint ventures in India. Since the beginning, Thales has been playing an essential role in India’s growth story by sharing its technologies and expertise in Defence, Aerospace and Cyber & Digital sectors. Thales has two engineering competence centres in India - one in Noida focused on Cyber & Digital business, while the one in Bengaluru focuses on hardware, software and systems engineering capabilities for both the civil and defence sectors, serving global needs. The Group has also established an MRO (Maintenance, Repair & Overhaul) facility in Gurugram to provide comprehensive avionics maintenance and repair services to Indian airlines and support the growth of the local aviation industry.

**Position Summary**

This position is responsible for maintaining user and system uptime on Thales InFlyt Experience’s Ground System that is the source for all In-Flight Entertainment on many commercial airlines throughout the world. Technical TechOps Lead should exhibit strong technical and communication skills to collaborate with team, product management, technical support, and customer. Spends more than 75% time as individual contributor and rest for other activities. Should have complete understanding of the product, including the end-to-end use cases. Works with complete autonomy, not needing any guidance. The TechOps Technical Lead will be responsible for improving system experiences through remote monitoring, maintenance and problem identification and resolution activities, as well as growing and developing the organization’s perception with existing customers through exceptional customer service. Will be responsible to mentor the team members and act as an escalation point for any unresolved issues from the Level I/II team.

* Windows Server Monitoring, Maintenance and Support
* Web-based Application Monitoring, Maintenance and Support
* Identifying, documenting and troubleshooting network, systems, applications and cloud issues to resolution.
* Ground System Incident and Problem Management

* Design, implement, and maintain monitoring systems using Datadog, building dashboards, monitors, and alerts to proactively identify and resolve issues.
* Collaborate with cross-functional teams to define, implement, and improve operational processes and best practices.
* Oversee the configuration and management of GitLab, Terraform, and other DevOps tools to streamline deployment and infrastructure management.
* Performing daily system monitoring, verifying the integrity and availability of all hardware, networking equipment, server resources, systems and key processes, reviewing system, error and application logs, and verifying completion of scheduled jobs and tasks.
* Production and Test environments platform monitoring for alarms and performance issues on systems, applications, database and network connectivity.
* Working rotating shifts in a 24x7 NOC environment
* Performing assigned daily, weekly and monthly operations maintenance duties.
* Operating system provisioning and maintenance
* Application and operating system service restarts
* Performs Enterprise back-up and restorations
* Assists in knowledgebase management
* Assist with changes to platform hardware and software
* Resolves application, database and operating system related monitoring events
* Troubleshoots LAN/WAN
* Performs Moves, Adds and Changes within the monitoring environments
* Work effectively with internal/external technical resources and customer-facing organizations to resolve incidents quickly and efficiently
* Follows prescribed processes for Incident, Change and Problem management

* Cross Training Departmental Team Members

* Enjoys troubleshooting and solving problems
